title: A New Family of Homo- and Heterometallic Manganese Complexes at High Oxidation States Derived from the Oxidation of MnII with CeIV: Syntheses, Structures, and Magnetic Properties

material_class.structural_family: salt of a [Mn3O4]4+ oxomanganese cluster and a mononuclear cerium(III) nitrate aqua anion

synthesis.procedure: All manipulations were performed under aerobic conditions. Solid 2,2'-bipyridine (0.62 g, 4 mmol) was added to a stirred red solution of Mn(pta)2·2H2O (1.08 g, 3 mmol) in EtOH/dmf (35 mL, v/v 6:1), giving a yellow suspension. Concentrated nitric acid (63%, 5 mL) was added to give a clear solution. Solid (NH4)2[Ce(NO3)6] (5.48 g, 10 mmol) was added in portions over 1 h, producing a clear dark solution. The mixture was stirred overnight at ambient temperature, filtered, and the filtrate left undisturbed for several days. X-ray quality block crystals of 2 were collected by filtration, washed with water, and dried in air.
synthesis.time: addition of CAN over 1 h, then stirred overnight; crystals after several days
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtered; filtrate left undisturbed; crystals collected, washed with water, dried in air

properties.summary: Variable-temperature susceptibility (2–300 K, 10 kG) shows strong antiferromagnetic coupling among the MnIV centers of the [Mn3O4] core. Room-temperature χMT is 1.90 cm3 K mol−1, remaining nearly constant to 2 K. Fitting as χM = χM(Mn) + χM(Ce) gave J = −176.5 cm−1, gMn = 1.97, gJ = 0.86, θ = −0.50 K, and R = 3.57×10−4. The CeIII counterion is paramagnetic (f1) and was modeled with a Curie–Weiss term.

measurements.name: J (Mn–Mn)
measurements.conditions: isotropic Hamiltonian for the Mn3 core; full 2–300 K fit

source_locations.location: Magnetic Properties of Complexes 1 to 4; Figure 9

synthesis.procedure: All manipulations were performed under aerobic conditions. Solid (NH4)2[Ce(NO3)6] (1.64 g, 3.0 mmol) was added in batches over 0.5 h to a stirred red solution of Mn(pta)2·2H2O (0.72 g, 2 mmol) in EtOH/dmf (35 mL, v/v 6:1), giving a clear brown solution. The mixture was stirred at room temperature for 4 h and filtered. The filtrate stood undisturbed for several weeks at room temperature, depositing red-brown amorphous crystalline material. X-ray quality crystals of 3 were obtained by recrystallization from MeCN.
synthesis.time: CAN addition over 0.5 h; stirred 4 h; crystals after several weeks
synthesis.ph: nearly neutral medium (as discussed in Syntheses)
synthesis.vessel_or_method: aerobic stirring, filtration, undisturbed crystallization, recrystallization from MeCN
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtered; filtrate left undisturbed for several weeks; amorphous red-brown solids recrystallized from MeCN to give X-ray quality crystals

properties.summary: Weak overall antiferromagnetic coupling between two MnIV ions (CeIV is diamagnetic). χMT = 3.59 cm3 K mol−1 at room temperature (spin-only 3.75 cm3 K mol−1 for two isolated S = 3/2 MnIV), essentially constant until a small drop near 10 K. Fit of Ĥ = −2J Ŝ1Ŝ2 (S1 = S2 = 3/2) over 2–300 K gave J = −0.46 cm−1, g = 1.93, TIP = 500×10−6 cm3 mol−1 (fixed), P = 0.039, R = 4.21×10−4. The small J is consistent with 4.798(2) Å Mn···Mn separation and long four-bond superexchange pathways.

synthesis.procedure: All manipulations were performed under aerobic conditions. 4,4'-Bipyridine (0.31 g, 2 mmol) was added to a stirred red solution of Mn(pta)2·2H2O (0.72 g, 2 mmol) in MeCN/dmf (20 mL, v/v 3:1). Solid (NH4)2[Ce(NO3)6] was then introduced (quantities as given in the Experimental Section for 4). After stirring, the dark filtrate was allowed to evaporate naturally; crystals of 4 formed within one week, were collected by filtration, and dried in air. Yield 0.40 g (30% based on Mn).

synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: crystals collected by filtration and dried in air

properties.summary: Predominantly ferromagnetic interactions among eight MnIII ions (CeIV diamagnetic) with a relatively large spin ground state. χMT = 22.65 cm3 K mol−1 at room temperature (cf. 24 cm3 K mol−1 for eight isolated MnIII), rises to 28.91 cm3 K mol−1 near 50 K, then falls to 6.22 cm3 K mol−1 at 2 K. Reduced-magnetization fits (2.0–10.0 K, 5–40 kG) with Anisofit2.0 assuming only the ground state is populated gave S = 7, D = −0.0058 cm−1, g = 1.87; S = 6 or 8 did not improve the fit.
